map.制版与成本估算时，由单张面积×定量得到单张克重，再乘印量估算总用纸量。: For plate making and cost estimation, get the basis weight of one sheet from single-sheet area x grammage, then multiply by the print run to estimate total paper use.
map.印刷与造纸工艺中，定量（g/m²）是最基础指标，需在 g/m²、磅(lb)、盎司: In printing and papermaking, basis weight (g/m2) is the most fundamental metric and must be converted among g/m2, pounds (lb) and ounces per square yard for paper selection and quoting.
map.在 GSM（克/平方米）、令重与磅重（lb）之间互相换算，输入任一参数求其余指标: Convert among GSM (grams per square meter), ream weight and pound weight (lb) by entering any one parameter to get the others. Useful for a unified basis-weight statement in printing and paper purchasing.
map.定量 g/m² 与 磅(lb) 怎么换算？: How do you convert g/m2 basis weight to pounds (lb)?
ISO B is 787x1092mm = 0.8594 m2 and ISO A is 889x1194mm = 1.061 m2; at the same basis weight an A-size ream weighs about 23% more than a B-size ream. Always state the paper size in quotes and layouts.
map.正度、大度纸的面积差多少？: How much do ISO B and ISO A paper areas differ?
map.磅(lb)通常指『500 张大度纸的令重』，近似 1 lb≈1.128 g/m²: A pound (lb) usually means the ream weight of 500 sheets of A-size paper, approximately 1 lb = 1.128 g/m2 (that is gsm x 0.895 = lb per ream). More rigorously, use the ream weight formula on the actual paper size to avoid mixing sizes.

map.采购与仓储中，按『令』（通常 500 张）计算令重(kg/lb)，便于运输计量与: In purchasing and warehousing, compute the ream weight (kg/lb) by the ream (usually 500 sheets) to simplify shipping measurement and inventory management.
map.：1) 令重(500张大度)≈80×0.895=71.6 lb；2) 盎司/平方: : 1) ream weight (500 A-size sheets) = 80 x 0.895 = 71.6 lb; 2) ounces per square yard = 80 x 0.02949 = 2.36 oz/yd2; 3) one A4 sheet (0.21 x 0.297 m) weighs 80 x 0.21 x 0.297 = 5.00 g. Formula: pounds = gsm x 0.895 (an approximation for 500 A-size sheets).
map.：单张面积=0.787×1.092=0.8594 m²；单张重=70×0.859: : sheet area = 0.787 x 1.092 = 0.8594 m2; sheet weight = 70 x 0.8594 = 60.16 g; ream weight = 60.16 x 500 = 30079 g = 30.08 kg (about 66.3 lb). Formula: ream weight = basis weight x sheet area x sheet count.
